dialogue.content: こんにちは。メンタルトレーナーの風です。こちらのテーマは　メンタルトレーニング　恋愛　となります。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm Kaze, a mental trainer. The theme for this session is mental training for romance. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: I look forward to it as well.

dialogue.content: お越しいただきありがとうございます。恋愛に関するご相談ですよね。今日はどのようなご相談になりますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in. You're here to discuss a romantic relationship, is that correct? What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 婚活が上手く行きません
dialogue.English: My search for a marriage partner isn’t going well.

dialogue.content: 婚活ですね。よろしかったら年齢と性別と、なんてお呼びしたらいいか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see, you're looking for a marriage partner. If you don't mind, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what I should call you?

dialogue.content: こと、女性、34歳です
dialogue.English: I'm Koto, a 34-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。どんなところがうまくいかないと感じていらっしゃるんですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What aspects of it do you feel aren't going well?

dialogue.content: 出会いがないって感じです
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm just not meeting anyone.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。日常生活ではなかなか難しいこともありますよね。今何か活動されているんですか？
dialogue.English: I see. It can be difficult in your day-to-day life, can't it? Are you currently doing anything to try and meet people?

dialogue.content: マッチングアプリを使っています
dialogue.English: I'm using dating apps.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。今セキュリティしっかりしているものもいろいろあるようですよね。なかなか希望の人と出会いがないって感じですか？
dialogue.English: I see. There seem to be many apps with good security these days. Do you feel that you're not meeting the kind of people you're hoping for?

dialogue.content: そうですね、デート2回目くらいでだいたい終わってしまって…それが続くからだんだん疲れてきました。
dialogue.English: Yes, things usually end around the second date… and since that keeps happening, I’m getting worn out.

dialogue.content: あーそれは疲れてしまいますよね。会うだけでも緊張しますもんね
dialogue.English: Ah, that must be exhausting. Just meeting up with someone can be nerve-wracking.

dialogue.content: そうなんです、毎回一から自己紹介して…これ何回繰り返すのかなーって…疲れます、、
dialogue.English: Exactly. I have to introduce myself from scratch every time... It makes me wonder how many more times I have to do this... It’s so tiring.

dialogue.content: そうですよねぇ。よくわかります。デートが終わるのはことさんが合わないなぁって感じて断ってらっしゃるんですか？
dialogue.English: I completely understand. Are the dates ending because you feel it's not a good match and you decide to turn them down?

dialogue.content: どっちもあります。相手から連絡来なかったり、こっちからブロックしちゃったり…ブロックも申し訳ないと思いつつ合わない人とやりとりが面倒くさくって…
dialogue.English: It's a bit of both. Sometimes they stop contacting me, and other times I end up blocking them. I feel bad about it, but it's such a hassle to keep talking with someone I don't click with.

dialogue.content: 申し訳ないと思う必要は全然ないと思いますよ！お相手も合う人を探してるんですから合わないなら早く判断してあげることは親切なのかなぁと私は思いますよ。ことさんの希望の結婚相手はどんな人なんですか？
dialogue.English: I don't think you need to feel bad at all! The other person is also looking for someone they're compatible with, so I think it's actually kind to make a quick decision if it's not a match. What kind of person are you hoping to marry, Koto?

dialogue.content: そうかぁ、そんな見方もあるんですね。めんどくささと罪悪感でめげそうになってました…
dialogue.English: I see. That's another way of looking at it. I was getting so discouraged by the hassle and the guilt...

dialogue.content: 結婚相手…
dialogue.English: A marriage partner...

dialogue.content: 私、仕事大好きなので仕事をやってていいよーって人がいいですね！それが第1です。
dialogue.English: I love my work, so I'd like someone who is fine with me continuing to work. That's my number one priority.

dialogue.content: おー、素敵ですねー
dialogue.English: Oh, that's wonderful.

dialogue.content: そうですか！意外と男性は女性バリバリ嫌がる人多いです
dialogue.English: You think so? Surprisingly, a lot of men dislike women who are very career-driven.

dialogue.content: バリバリ仕事って意味です
dialogue.English: I mean working intensely.

dialogue.content: 仕事してる女性が素敵っていう方もたくさんいらっしゃると思いますよ。ではお相手の方も仕事が好きな方がいい感じですか？
dialogue.English: I think there are plenty of people who find working women attractive. So, would you prefer a partner who also loves his work?

dialogue.content: そうですね、相手も仕事じゃなくても好きなこと持ってた方がいいですかね。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think it would be better if he had something he was passionate about, even if it wasn't his work.

dialogue.content: いいですねー。他には希望してることはありますか？
dialogue.English: That's great. Is there anything else you're looking for?

dialogue.content: うーん、私の仕事に対して口出さない感じ。…仕事のことばっかりですけど。
dialogue.English: Hmm, someone who won't interfere with my work... It's all about work, I know.

dialogue.content: うんうん。とてもお仕事が好きなことが伝わりますね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. It really comes across that you love your work.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: だって仕事って裏切らないし、報酬もらえるし…恋愛って必ずしもそうじゃないから
dialogue.English: Because work doesn't betray you, and you get rewarded for it... Romance isn't necessarily like that.

dialogue.content: すごく真摯にお仕事に取り組まれているんですねー。そういう姿勢で婚活に取り組めば、真摯な男性に出会えるんじゃないですかねー
dialogue.English: You approach your work with such sincerity. If you approach your marriage hunt with that same attitude, I think you'll be able to meet a sincere man.

dialogue.content: そうですね、話してたら私、仕事第一優先しすぎてて恋愛とか結婚二の次なのかもって思ってきました！笑
dialogue.English: You're right. As we've been talking, I'm realizing I might be prioritizing work too much, putting romance and marriage second! (laughs)

dialogue.content: そうですか笑　でも今回婚活に取り組んでみようと思われたんですもんね！全力で応援させていただきます！
dialogue.English: I see (laughs). But you've decided to give marriage hunting a try this time, haven't you? I’ll support you wholeheartedly!

dialogue.content: ちなみに、どんな相手と出会いたいか考えておくと目の前に出てきたときにきたー！ってすぐ気が付くことができるので譲れないことは書き出しておくといいかなぁと思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, if you think beforehand about what kind of partner you want to meet, you'll be able to recognize them immediately when they appear, like, "This is it!" So, I think it might be a good idea to write down your non-negotiables. What do you think?

dialogue.content: 書き出して可視化するってことですかね。やってみます。
dialogue.English: You mean write it down to visualize it? I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: ちなみに
dialogue.English: By the way...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 相談員さんは30代半ばで恋愛してない女性ってどう思います？枯れてんなーとか思いません？
dialogue.English: As a counselor, what do you think of a woman in her mid-thirties who isn't dating? Do you ever think something like, 'She's past her prime'?

dialogue.content: あら、全然思いませんよ！だってそれだけ楽しいお仕事に出会えてるんですもの！
dialogue.English: Oh, not at all! It just means you've found a job that you truly enjoy!

dialogue.content: そうですか！周りも家族もみんな、そんな仕事ばっかりして…っていうから…汗
dialogue.English: Really? My friends and family all say things like, "All you do is work..." so...

dialogue.content: これから、大好きなお仕事プラス大好きなパートナーをみつけていってもっと素敵な未来をつかみましょう
dialogue.English: From now on, let's find a partner you love to add to the work you love, and seize an even more wonderful future.

dialogue.content: ちなみにいつくらいまでにご結婚されたいと思われていますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, around when would you like to get married?

dialogue.content: そうですねー！大好きが二乗になったら最高かもですね！
dialogue.English: You're right! Having the things I love squared would be the best, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですそうです！
dialogue.English: Exactly, exactly!

dialogue.content: 私はいつでもいいかなぁって思ってるんですけど、周りや家族がいろいろ言ってくるから
dialogue.English: For me, I feel like anytime would be fine, but my friends and family keep saying things...

dialogue.content: とはいえ、40歳くらいまでには！
dialogue.English: That said, by the time I'm 40!

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。いろいろ周りに言われるお年頃ではありますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It certainly is that age where people around you tend to have a lot to say, isn't it?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました。カウンセラー寄りの話になってしまった気が…。勉強になりました！)
dialogue.English: (Thank you. I feel like the conversation leaned a bit toward a counselor's perspective... It was a learning experience!)

dialogue.content: これで終了させていただきますね
dialogue.English: We'll conclude the session here.
